_about: Render area: fixed words the PDF renderer and the exporters write into documents in the document language (DocumentStrings, Sources/Render/DocumentStrings.swift). Keys are the English source text. Words already translated elsewhere are reused from there and not repeated here: Present, Dear %@,, Dear Hiring Manager,, Sincerely, and the default section headings (shell.json).

Contact._comment: Resume document content. Heading above the email, phone and links in the sidebar of a two-column resume.
